download.page.subtitle.message: Choose your system for the desktop app. Mobile and Linux versions are in active testing.

homepage.meta.description.message: EteDrop official site: product capabilities, guides, and technical docs.

homepage.publicE2e.diagram.caption.message: WebRTC end-to-end diagram: the cloud handles signaling; peers exchange data directly.

homepage.finalCta.subtitle.message: Start with the user guide to complete one transfer, then explore protocols and implementation details as needed.

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: Your tool for internet, LAN, and large files—boost your productivity.

homepage.publicE2e.lead.message: Works on the public internet: data goes directly between sender and receiver; the server handles sessions and signaling.

homepage.lanNotify.subtitle.message: System-level alerts—view in the app and accept with one tap.

homepage.lanNotify.p1.message: System notifications make new tasks, completion, and errors easier to notice.

homepage.lanNotify.p2.message: Transfer status at a glance: in progress, success, or failure.

homepage.lanTransfer.subtitle.message: Direct device-to-device on the same network—great for offices and multi-device setups.

homepage.lanTransfer.p1.message: Faster speeds, quick device discovery, custom avatars and names.

homepage.lanTransfer.p2.message: Files, text, clipboard images, and more—batch send and receive.

homepage.preview.lead.message: Preview directly in the browser—no app install needed for common formats.

homepage.useCases.subtitle.message: Not “another cloud drive”—faster, lighter, and more control over your transfers.

homepage.faq.1.q.message: Does it rely on centralized storage?

homepage.faq.1.a.message: Transfers prefer a direct peer-to-peer path; the server handles online coordination and signaling.

homepage.faq.2.q.message: Does it work on the public internet?

homepage.faq.2.a.message: Yes—about 80% of networks support P2P. If not, contact us with a screenshot.

homepage.faq.3.a.message: MP4 video (including play-while-receiving), common images, PDF, common audio, and plain text / many code & markup files. Office, archives, etc.: download and open locally. See the FAQ doc for limits.

homepage.faq.4.a.message: Send a screenshot and a short description to yuanzhou_cn@qq.com

homepage.publicE2e.feature.play.text.message: Preview PDF, images, audio, text & code, and MP4 video in the browser; video supports play-while-receiving.

homepage.publicE2e.feature.download.text.message: High-speed P2P downloads that use your bandwidth efficiently.

homepage.publicE2e.feature.privacy.text.message: Data stays off our servers—true peer-to-peer transfer.

homepage.publicE2e.feature.efficiency.te.message: No full cloud upload—P2P can cut transfer time by about half.

homepage.publicE2e.feature.easy.text.message: Click in the browser to download—no client required for recipients.

homepage.useCases.1.desc.message: PC and phone—get temporary files where you need them, fast.

homepage.useCases.2.desc.message: Links and pickup codes—less zipping and relaying.

homepage.useCases.3.desc.message: Send what you need without uploading everything to the cloud.

homepage.useCases.4.desc.message: Send to multiple people at once and speed up daily work.

homepage.useCases.5.desc.message: Preview PDF, images, media, and text in the browser; MP4 can play while receiving.

homepage.useCases.6.desc.message: Send directly between devices—multi-device sync coming later.
